duration: May 30 to Aug 14, 2027 (the page says both 10 and 11 weeks), one 3 to 4 hour shift a week
notes: You can miss up to 2 shifts. Call 614-722-3635 or email Volunteering@NationwideChildrens.org. The page has no direct apply link.
name: Teen Volunteering at Nationwide Children's Hospital (summer)
what_you_do: Help families, patients and staff under supervision at the hospital. You keep one weekly 3 to 4 hour shift from May 30 to Aug 14, 2027 and can move into new assignments if you do well.
who_can_apply: Teens who are 15 by June 1 and currently in high school. Competitive, with limited spots.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open Feb 1, 2027 at 5 p.m. and close Feb 2, 2027 at 5 p.m. The window lasts only 24 hours.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Get references who are not family to fill out an electronic form. Go to a group interview. Sign a commitment form. Get a TB test and send your shot records (flu, MMR, Tdap, chickenpox). Then finish an online orientation, a welcome visit and training for your job.
